Review Membership.io (formerly Searchie.io)?

Reviewers describe Membership.io as easy to use and especially helpful for hosting courses, memberships, coaching programs, private videos, and help resources. They repeatedly praise time-saving tools like transcription, captions, video search, condensed summaries, and content repurposing for social posts or training materials. Several users also highlight WisdomAI for pulling answers from a creator’s own library and surfacing source-backed responses. Support is described as friendly and strong. The only clear drawback mentioned is that the pace of product updates can be hard to keep up with.
